It has electric front windows, central locking and a working radio. Recently serviced with new oil, oil filter and air filter. Will be sold inspected and ready to go. Sold as seen, viewing in Karlstad.

title: Volkswagen Golf 2013 1.4 TSI
description: Time to let go of my beloved Volkswagen Golf — I'm moving abroad next month. It's a petrol with automatic gearbox, currently at 143000 km. Small petrol engine, cheap to insure and run. New brake pads and discs all around this spring. The car presents very well, recently polished and the interior is in great shape. New inspection completed at sale, included in the price. The price is negotiable within reason.
